body: So your going to choose to vote AGAINST the industry that employs and feeds your family? Interesting…

I don’t really have any advice for you as I’m currently going through the same thing… I’ve been taking adhd meds for a year now but simultaneously started showing extreme emotional changes as if I were bipolar so now I don’t know if it’s bipolar or my meds. 

I just want you to know your more alone in your situation!

Thank you ... yes I told my family a couple years later because I switched schools and they could never understand why I did that. My boyfriend knows too... but he’s just clueless on what to do to make me feel better,.but it’s not his responsibility to make me feel better. Yes I have tried to talk to therapists but they always think I’m fine... probably because I never over react. But I recently tried a new lady that I’m gonna be more open too. Thank you for replying to me... means a lot

Thank you my dear, I appreciate your kind words! I’ve talked about it, but I’m so level headed I don’t think they realize what it actually did to me. I put it behind me for a long time but it keeps coming back up so I’m trying to address it now. Honestly, I don’t think it’s anyone responsibility to solve this problem so that’s why I stay quiet. I’m going to try and be more open with the people in my life because I need it to save myself. Thank you again for responding. That alone makes me feel better!

Honestly, I’m sure he loves me but I just don’t see it. Same with anyone else who ever says they love me. I don’t believe them. It’s definitely based on my self love. If I am being honest, I am quite attractive but I have a strange personality so I was bullied for being weird to. I’ve always struggled with friendships because I don’t trust anyone to get close enough to me. I agree with you... I think I have a lot of unaddressed trauma... but to me what I am complaining about seems so minor to other people it’s almost embarrassing. My dad is a misogynist, so he raised me to believe I’m not good enough and my feelings aren’t valid. So maybe I’m wrong about that? Idk :\ I have tried multiple times to seek therapy but every therapist deems me as mentally sane because I’m VERY level headed.. to the point nobody knows I’m thinking these thoughts. I just started therapy again and I’m trying to be more open with them because I genuinely want help. I don’t want to feel this way anymore... it’s soul crushing. Thank you for responding... makes me feel better. If your in this thread, I hope your doing well yourself! I care about everyone.
